messages:
sara (People Ops): quick q — our 401k auto-escalator is set to bump people +1% on July 1. can folks opt out? what's the opt-out deadline?

mike (Payroll): yes they can opt out. deadline is payroll cutoff for the pay period that includes July 1. for us that cutoff is two business days before the payroll run. so for the July 1 pay period the cutoff is 2024-06-28. :calendar:

sara (People Ops): thanks — do we need people to submit a form in adp/portal or is it just a checkbox in Benefits portal? trying to draft comms.

mike (Payroll): they need to change their deferral in the benefits portal (not an email). portal saves election and feeds to payroll. we can't process opt-outs retroactively once cutoff passes.

nina (IC): if someone is on parental leave and misses the cutoff, can we do a retro adjustment?

mike (Payroll): only if it's an admin-initiated manual adjustment before payroll posts. after funds disburse, reversals get messy (tax withholding diffs). we usually avoid unless it's a clear vendor error.

sara (People Ops): one more twist — several folks have HSA pre-tax elections that are still on the old payroll vendor staging because of the cutover. do HSA elections need a separate sync or will the benefits feed pick them up automatically?

dave (BenefitsVendor): HSA elections are a separate feed. if employee made the change in the benefits portal before the migration cutover, we will include it in the next export. if it was updated in payroll directly during the vendor migration window, payroll needs to push the delta to us.

mike (Payroll): calling that out — during the migration we asked employees not to update elections directly in payroll. unfortunately a few did. we have a small manual reconciliation step but need a definitive list to avoid over/under withholding.

sara (People Ops): ok — action items for comms: 1) tell people opt-out must be done in benefits portal by 2024-06-28, 2) if you're on leave and missed cutoff, contact people-ops ASAP (we'll try to help but no promises), 3) if you updated HSA in payroll during cutover email payroll@redwood.com and cc benefits@redwood.com so we can reconcile.

nina (IC): can we add a snippet in the email showing how to opt-out? small code-like piece might help non-technical folks.

sara (People Ops): good idea. draft:
```
Benefits portal -> Retirement -> 401(k) elections -> Auto-Escalation -> Toggle OFF -> Save
```

mike (Payroll): that looks good. i'll confirm with the migration team we can accept reconciliation requests until 2024-07-10. i'll update payroll@ auto-reply with cutoff dates.

hr-bot: Helpful guide: https://internal.redwood.com/hr/401k-escalator (internal doc) :link:

sara (People Ops): perfect — i'll schedule the comms for tomorrow morning and include the deadlines + how-to. thanks all :thumbsup:
